recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast portrait of a man with dark hair and a mustache wearing mirrored aviator sunglasses, set against a vibrant, out-of-focus green and floral background. The composition is framed by a thin white line and topped with bold, cyan-filled slab-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The mirrored sunglasses reflect the sky, creating a blue-to-green color link with the background.
The thin white border contains the subject while allowing the head and top text to break the frame.
The cyan text color contrasts against the warm skin tones and yellow-green background.
coreInvariants: Mirrored aviator sunglasses reflecting a blue sky
Prominent dark mustache and short-cropped dark hair
Thin white rectangular frame inset from the edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned centrally, tilted slightly, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The mirrored sunglasses serve as the primary focal point due to their high contrast and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold cyan title at the top, moves down to the sunglasses, and follows the subject's shoulder line toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dominated by the blurred background and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with deep shadows on the face and bright highlights from direct sunlight.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muted or pastel tones; stick to primary-adjacent vibrance.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with geometric proportions
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a sturdy, straight leg
The 'M' is wide with a deep central valley

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the background above the subject's head

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, high-contrast serif for secondary metadata placed in the upper right corner.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and geometric structure.
Provides the necessary blocky serifs and tight counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with a mustache and aviator sunglasses in bright sunlight. The background should be a lush, out-of-focus garden with green and pink bokeh. Add a thin white rectangular border inset from the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a heavy cyan slab-serif font with a thin white outline at the top, centered. Add a smaller subtitle in white serif font in the top right corner, just below the main title.

verificationChecks: Does the text break the top of the white frame?
Are the sunglasses reflecting a blue sky?
Is the main font a heavy slab serif?
Is the color palette dominated by green, cyan, and warm skin tones?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the celebrity
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white border is perfectly rectangular.
Verify the cyan text has a visible white outline.
Check that the mustache is prominent and well-defined.
Confirm the background is sufficiently blurred to create depth.
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Portrait + Mirrored Aviators + Slab Serif Header + Inset Border Frame
